tool: Gitleaks 8.30.1 plus exact operator-secret and credential-pattern scanning
scope: All local refs and reflogs, commit/tag messages, historical blobs, index, current tracked files; known operator secrets and credential patterns. Matched values are never logged.
reviewedCandidates: Configuration placeholders and the explicitly public Anvil local-development fixture; no operator key, PAT, SSH key, database credential or private notebook plaintext was found.
limit: Automated and manual publication checks, not an independent security audit. Prior GitHub caches and external copies cannot be erased by rewriting repository references.
